patch_name: Initial plan extension to meet IK feasibility requirement
patch_description: The current plan has only one mode, which is insufficient for the IK solver to evaluate. The IK solver requires at least two modes: an initial mode and at least one transition mode. To meet this requirement, we will extend the plan by appending at least one more mode that differs from the initial one. This will ensure that the plan has at least two modes, making it feasible for the IK solver to evaluate.
